fieldData.meta-title: Meet the Teacher Sign In Sheet for Your Class | Emergent
fieldData.meta-description: Build a meet the teacher sign in sheet that collects dismissal plans, volunteer roles, and home language, then emails absent families the packet.
fieldData.description: Build a meet the teacher sign in sheet families fill in at the door, saved as a class contact list in a database you own.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { kindergarten: "Build a meet the teacher sign in sheet for my kindergarten class at Quarrybend Elementary. Families sign in on a tablet by my door with the child's name, their own name, email, and phone. Check each sign-in against my roster of 22 children and keep a list of families who have not signed in. At 8:00 AM the next morning, email every family still on that list my welcome packet link.", secondGrade: "Build a sign-in sheet for my second grade meet the teacher night. Ask each family how their child gets home on the first day: car, bus, after-care, or walking. If they pick bus, ask for the bus number. Sort my 24 students into a dismissal list grouped by way home, with bus riders listed under their bus number.", fourthGrade: "Build a sign-in sheet for my fourth grade meet the teacher night where families can also pick a volunteer role. I need 2 room parents and 4 field trip chaperones. Show each role with the spots left, and mark a role full when its spots are taken so the next family only sees roles that are still open. Show me who took each role.", sixthGrade: "Build a sign-in sheet for my sixth grade homeroom's meet the teacher night. Ask each family for the student's name, a parent's name, a phone number, and the language they want school notes in: English, Spanish, or Korean. Group my contact list by that language and show a count for each one, so our family liaison knows how many notes need a translated copy." };
